sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Words Spy. Animals is a word-finding game that requires players to locate words hidden within a grid of letters. The game starts with a simple grid of 6x6 letters, and as players progress through the levels, the grid size increases to 8x8, 10x10, and even larger. The letters themselves become more complex, including uppercase and lowercase letters, special characters, and even accents.

         The gameplay mechanics are simple yet engaging, with players using their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to select letters and form words. The game features multiple word lengths, from short three-letter words to longer phrases, making it essential to develop a keen eye for patterns and connections. Players can choose to play in a grid mode, where letters are arranged randomly, or in a list mode, where words are presented in a linear format.

         One of the key features of Words Spy. Animals is its ability to adapt to the player's skill level. As players progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly challenging, with more complex words and larger grids. However, the game also offers a helpful hint system, which provides players with a subtle nudge in the right direction. This feature is perfect for players who need a little extra assistance or for those who are new to word games.
